title: My first released game: One More Petal, made in Unity with ChatGPT/Codex
author: eschaff2114
selftext:
I just submitted One More Petal to the Official 2026 Unity Game Jam! The theme was “Lucky Number,” and this is the first game I’ve fully put out there while I finish some others. 😄

It’s a small action game where you protect a greenhouse from approaching flowers with a returning scythe. The lucky number matters through your petal basket: gather exactly the right number and you trigger Lucky Bloom, clearing the flowers and restoring a life. Go over and the basket spills, creating more trouble.

It’s free to play in a desktop browser. The approach lasts ten minutes, followed by a boss that usually took me another minute or two to beat.

I used ChatGPT and OpenAI Codex throughout development, from working through the specification to coding, testing and revisions. OpenAI image-generation tools produced the pixel art and UI artwork, and Codex helped develop the music and synthesize the sound effects. I supplied the idea, directed the look and feel, and kept playtesting and asking for changes.

The biggest part of the process was iteration. The early music felt way too cozy for flowers attacking, we had changed from same flowers with different colors to completely different flowers, we started with the greenhouse showing at the front of the playfield instead of the back, and the boss needed a clearer way to show when it could be hit. 

Testing also taught me not to assume that a successful build meant everything worked. At one point, sound effects played but the music didn’t. That needed a separate fix and browser checks. I also had AI help with automated tests and simulated runs, alongside my own playtesting to judge whether it actually felt challenging and fair.

I’d love feedback on the game, especially whether the basket feels like a meaningful choice and whether the sound and visuals work together. For others developing with AI, what took the most iteration to get right?

Play here: [https://ladyrogue.itch.io/one-more-petal](https://ladyrogue.itch.io/one-more-petal)
